{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Charcoal wool-blend sheath dress, knee-length cut, #2f353a color, structured fabric.
Silver-tone heeled pumps, medium height and slender silhouette, #C0C0C0 color, polished leather.
Pearl drop earrings, medium length and delicate design, White color (#FFFFFF), cultured pearl and 18k white gold setting.
Clasp necklace, short length resting at the collarbone, Silver color (#E5E4E2), sterling silver with small diamond accents.

This ensemble creates an elegant silhouette perfect for an evening theatre performance while respecting the social formality of the event. The charcoal dress offers a sophisticated neutral base that harmonizes beautifully with her light skin tone and ash-blonde hair without competing with stage lighting or other costumes. Heeled pumps elongate the legs to balance her height, while the subtle silver jewelry adds a refined touch appropriate for an evening occasion without appearing overly flashy in artificial light."}
